0.promptText:
Use case: sketch-to-render / style-transfer.
Asset: one polished numeral "0" for a pre-baked Roo image font.
Image 1 is the authoritative FLAT BLACK-AND-WHITE LETTERFORM. Treat every black area as one continuous solid glyph, including the broad rising internal stroke. Preserve this exact outer contour, counter shape, thick accent, pointed terminals, proportions, and straight-on orientation. White areas must remain empty. The accent is part of the letter's original construction, not a separate object laid over a finished zero.
Image 2 is a MATERIAL AND LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY. Apply its rugged, carved 3D bevel and warm gradient to the entire flat zero from Image 1. Do not copy Image 2's unaccented hole or blurry pixels.
Shade the whole connected zero afresh as a single carved body. Use one coherent broad smooth front face with a narrow sculpted chamfer, about 3–4% of the cap height, continuously wrapping the outer edge, inner counter, and broad accent. At the accent's root the front face must join the left stem seamlessly. There must be no old inner rim, seam, extra ridge, or shadow line passing through that root. Give the accent the same substantial face and bevel proportions as the rest of the character; retain its broad body and short pointed tip, never turn it into a thin hairline, leaf, or metallic sliver.
Match the reference's rich golden-yellow upper face, amber/orange middle, and saturated red-vermilion foot. Use small lemon-yellow upper edge highlights, restrained warm shading on the chamfers, and polished smooth antialiased edges. Keep the finish clean and continuous at high magnification, with crisp carved facets and restrained glints. The top-left light and softer opposite fill must illuminate the ring and accent consistently. No inflated tubing, chrome, black surround, drop shadow, painted checkerboard, texture grain, scratches, extra cuts, noisy gradients, white streaks, extra text or objects.
Return only one complete numeral "0", centered with generous margins, on a truly transparent background, including transparency in its counter. Preserve the exact silhouette and thick internal stroke from Image 1.
